claims.text: The hotel is located across from the Disneyland Resort and next to the Anaheim Convention Center.

findings.quote: The Westin Anaheim Resort is a AAA Four Diamond hotel located across from Disneyland Resort and next to the Anaheim Convention Center.
findings.note: The page states both location elements directly.

findings.quote: Located across from the Disneyland® Resort and adjacent to the Anaheim Convention Center
findings.note: A second official page confirms both location elements.

claims.text: It sits directly across Katella Avenue from Disney California Adventure Park, within walking distance of the Disneyland Resort.

findings.quote: Being directly across Katella Avenue from Disney California Adventure® Park, the hotel is perfectly situated within walking distance to the Disneyland® Resort
findings.note: Covers both the Katella Avenue position and walking distance to the resort.

claims.text: The hotel is a Disney Good Neighbor Hotel in the highest category, the Superior Hotel Category.

findings.quote: As a Disney Good Neighbor Hotel, The Westin Anaheim Resort is designated in the highest category level of the Good Neighbor hotel rating system, the Superior Hotel Category.
findings.note: States the Good Neighbor status, the highest category and its name.

claims.text: The hotel is arranged around a central courtyard, rises gradually up to eight stories, and uses biophilic design to connect guests to nature.

findings.quote: arranged around a spacious central courtyard, and massing gradually up to eight stories, the hotel’s contemporary classical architecture with biophilia design connects guests to nature in modern, relaxed surroundings.
findings.note: Covers the courtyard, the eight stories and the biophilic design.

claims.text: Live potted citrus trees line the entrance, the lobby and the rooftop.

findings.quote: Live potted citrus trees border the porte cochere and front entrance of the hotel, in the lobby of the hotel, and on the rooftop of the hotel.
findings.note: Names all three locations: entrance, lobby and rooftop.

claims.text: A living green wall stands behind the check-in counters.

findings.quote: The living green wall behind the hotel check-in counters reflect the core principles of biophilia
findings.note: Directly states the wall's location behind the check-in counters.

claims.text: Most Theme Park View rooms offer the option of a balcony.

findings.quote: Most of the Theme Park View rooms offer the option for a standing balcony, or larger balcony area with
findings.note: Directly supports the balcony option for most Theme Park View rooms.

claims.text: The 24-hour Westin WORKOUT Fitness Studio has floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the outdoor pool.

findings.quote: Open 24/7, the 2,860 square feet Westin WORKOUT® Fitness Studio is outfitted with floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the resort’s outdoor pool
findings.note: Covers 24-hour opening, floor-to-ceiling windows and the pool view.

claims.text: Family activities include Resort Art Quest, where kids search for clues to nature-inspired art pieces in the hotel, and Yoga Fun for Little Ones.

findings.quote: Enjoy family friendly activities including Wellness Walks, Resort Art Quest (kids search for clues to nature-inspired art pieces in the hotel), Yoga Fun for Little Ones
findings.note: Names both activities and describes Resort Art Quest as claimed.

claims.text: Concierge associates can help with Disney theme park ticket purchases and park reservations on-site, subject to availability.

findings.quote: The hotel concierge associates can assist with Disney theme park ticket purchases and park reservations on-site, per availability.
findings.note: Covers ticket purchases, park reservations and the availability caveat.

claims.text: RISE Rooftop Lounge is a tapas-style rooftop bar with live music and views of Disney California Adventure Park.

findings.quote: Awarded OpenTable 2025 Diners' Choice, our tapas-style Anaheim rooftop bar offers shareable plates, handcrafted cocktails, live music, and views of Disney® California Adventure Park.
findings.note: Covers tapas style, live music and the park views.

claims.text: Theme Park View rooms, studios and suites look over Disney California Adventure Park and let guests watch the Disneyland Resort fireworks.

findings.quote: Elevate your stay in one of the signature Theme Park View guestrooms, which have spectacular views of Disney California Adventure® Park.
findings.note: Establishes the views over Disney California Adventure Park.

findings.quote: The Theme Park View deluxe guestrooms, studios, and suites are the optimal choice to feel the energy of the theme parks and watch the Disneyland® Resort fireworks.
findings.note: Covers rooms, studios and suites and the fireworks viewing.

claims.text: The private top-floor Westin Club Lounge has panoramic views of the Disneyland Resort through floor-to-ceiling windows.

findings.quote: Private top-floor Club Lounge with panoramic views of Disneyland® Resort through floor-to-ceiling windows.
findings.note: Matches every element of the claim.

claims.text: The interior design is inspired by the modern orchard garden, a nod to Anaheim's agricultural origins.

findings.quote: Based on Anaheim’s historic agricultural origins, the interior design of The Westin Anaheim Resort is inspired by the modern orchard garden
findings.note: Links the modern orchard design to Anaheim's agricultural origins.

claims.text: A ground-level heated outdoor pool and whirlpool come with luxury cabanas.

findings.quote: Ground-level, heated outdoor swimming pool and whirlpool with five luxury cabanas
findings.note: Covers the ground-level heated pool, the whirlpool and the cabanas.

claims.text: The parks are a walk away rather than on site: the walk to the Disneyland Resort takes about 15 to 20 minutes for most visitors.

findings.quote: within walking distance to the Disneyland® Resort, about 15-20 minutes for most Disney fans.
findings.note: States the walk time of about 15-20 minutes for most visitors.

findings.quote: Most guests stay here due to its proximity to Disneyland, which is about a 15- to 20-minute walk away.
findings.note: The editorial review confirms the 15-20 minute walk.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes a high-traffic tourist area with frequent crowds.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing due to the Disney proximity.
